identity.notes: The requested Logan Circle cafe at 1924 14th Street NW closed in January 2026 and is absent from Compass Coffee's current official 16-cafe locator. The frozen source is a separate live Uber storefront at 849 18th Street NW, not Logan Circle. Current corporate ordering identifies the surviving chain as Compass Coffee By Caffè Nero; chain evidence is retained only in explicitly chain-scoped surfaces.

evidence.excerpt: Fresh complete All Items inspection for current Shaw, 1535 7th St NW, inventoried 77 unique food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail products across all 10 categories, with direct ingredient descriptions.
Fresh complete All Items inspection for current Dupont, 2150 P St NW, produced the same 77-product, 10-category inventory as Shaw. Out-of-stock entries were retained as current catalog products.

Fresh complete official All Coffee collection inspection, including all View More pages, inventoried 49 current packaged coffee and capsule products. Tasting notes such as milk chocolate or toasted nuts were not treated as ingredient or allergen claims.

Fresh complete official locator inspection lists 16 current Compass Coffee cafes, including Shaw and Dupont, but no Logan Circle or 1924 14th Street location. Current ordering brands the locations Compass Coffee By Caffè Nero.
Contemporaneous January 2026 closure reporting lists Compass Coffee's 1924 14th Street NW cafe among the locations closed during the chain's restructuring.

The frozen Uber storefront remains live at 849 18th Street NW with a broad menu, but that address is neither the requested former Logan Circle cafe nor a current official-locator entry. Its exclusive products are excluded from the current union.

Current corporate FAQ says breakfast sandwiches are available at all cafes and that cafes offer pastries and grab-and-go snacks. It discusses drink customization, coffee carriers, and Kosher certification but publishes no allergen matrix.
Current corporate homepage identifies Compass Coffee, links the official cafe locator and branded ordering application, and presents current retail coffee products.

Current official customization guidance says non-dairy milk substitutions are available without an extra charge and lists year-round flavor options. This is substitution guidance, not an allergen absence or cross-contact guarantee.
